Kit summary

Freezing BlowBasic
Deals 2 stages of 110% ATK DMG each to a single enemy, the 2nd stage of which has a 25% chance to inflict [Freeze] on them for 1 turn.
Swirling KickActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 3 stages of 120% ATK DMG to a single enemy. If the target is not under [Freeze] status, there is a 30% chance to inflict [Freeze] on them for 1 turn.
Christmas Candy Cane Lv.1If the target is not under [Freeze] status after Swirling Kick is cast, refreshes the CD of Swirling Kick. Meanwhile, Swirling Kick deals extra 60% Crit DMG.
Cold FreePassiveExclusive Lv.2
Rudolf gains extra Effect Hit by 30% of self initial Crit Rate (up to 30%). When an ally is killed by an enemy, Rudolf casts Freezing Blow 1 time to the enemy, with the chance to inflict [Freeze] increasing by 60%.
Christmas Candy Cane Lv.2Cold Free grants Rudolf Effect Hit bonus by the same amount of Effect RES bonus. Meanwhile, the chance to inflict [Freeze] increases to 90% and this [Freeze] cannot be cleansed.
Penetrating ColdActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 4 stages of 140% ATK DMG to a single enemy, the 4th stage of which has a 90% chance to inflict [Freeze] on them for 1 turn. If 2 or more stages trigger Crits, [Freeze] inflicted by this skill cannot be cleansed then. If all 4 stages trigger Crits, [Freeze] inflicted by this skill ignores [Block Debuff] and cannot be cleansed.
Christmas Candy Cane Lv.3The 4th stage of Penetrating Cold deals DMG to all enemies, with a 35% chance to inflict [Freeze] on enemies except for the main target. However, the extra effects of triggering Crits will not apply to any enemies other than the main target.
